name: Eat Flesh
overview: Scripture reveals that God granted humanity permission to eat all living creatures as food, as stated in Genesis 9:3, yet He strictly forbids the consumption of blood, emphasizing that the life is in the blood and must not be eaten (Leviticus 7:26, 17:10; Deuteronomy 12:23). The Lord’s commands concerning dietary practices, including prohibitions against eating certain animals like swine, underscore His holy standards and the need for obedience to His instructions (Isaiah 66:17; Leviticus 11:1). These regulations highlight the sacredness of life and the importance of honoring God’s design in what we eat.
